cues: Pure iron is a soft, silvery, strongly magnetic metal.
Dilute acids give iron two salts with hydrogen.
Strong oxidisers, chlorine and hot concentrated sulphuric acid, give iron three.
Concentrated nitric acid makes it passive: a thin oxide film stops all further attack.
And unlike zinc, iron does not react with alkali.
text: Pure iron is a soft, silvery, strongly magnetic metal. Dilute acids give iron two salts with hydrogen. Strong oxidisers, chlorine and hot concentrated sulphuric acid, give iron three. Concentrated nitric acid makes it passive: a thin oxide film stops all further attack. And unlike zinc, iron does not react with alkali.
